chin-up.criteria: Shoulder-width underhand grip, fixed hands on overhead bar, lift chin above bar without leg swing, controlled lowering.

wide-grip-pull-up.criteria: Overhand grip wider than shoulders, elbows lead down/out, chin rises above bar, controlled full cycle without swinging.

smith-bench-press.criteria: Flat bench and planted feet, back/head supported; overhand grip outside shoulders, vertical fixed rail bar to chest and controlled press. Adapted from wide-grip source to moderate grip.

limits: Procedural human and equipment reused with new grips/timing/camera. Simplified anatomy. Sampled checks are not full collision or biomechanical certification; production and physical-device validation pending.
